Statement._comment: s3:PutObject on uploads/* is required to generate presigned PUT URLs. The AWS SDK signs the URL using the caller's credentials. If the role lacked s3:PutObject here, generate_presigned_upload_url() would produce a URL that S3 rejects with 403 when the browser tries to use it.

s3:GetObject is required to generate presigned GET URLs (download endpoint). s3:HeadObject is required for object_exists() and get_object_size() called in POST /uploads/{job_id}/complete — the API verifies the file was uploaded and checks its size via HeadObject before transitioning the job to queued. Both uploads/* and processed/* are included because the download presigned URL covers processed/* objects.

Required for ENVIRONMENT=production. The API Lambda calls _build_database_url() at module import time to fetch the DB password from Secrets Manager. Same cold-start failure mode as the worker if this is absent.
